name: Shoulder flexion
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
Press your lower back flat into the floor and keep it there for the whole test.
With your thumb pointing up and elbow straight, raise one arm forward and overhead as far as it goes toward the floor behind you.
Place a phone inclinometer along your upper arm and read the angle from your side: arm by your hip is 0, straight up is 90, flat on the floor beside your ear is 180.
If your back arches, your ribs flare or your elbow bends, stop at the point just before it happens and read the angle there.
